programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Burning Evidence : Identifying Burned Remains: It's difficult to have a murder investigation without a body, and burning up the victim is a time-honored method of destroying physical evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Women Who Kill : Men don't have a monopoly on murder, but it's still extraordinary when women kill. Though female killers are as deadly as males, they choose less violent methods.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Price of Murder : Using science as their most powerful weapon, investigators must find these hired killers and make them pay the true price of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Remnant of Blame : The solution to the most heinous crimes often hinge on the smallest of clues. Investigators must have their eyes trained to find the full story of a murder written in a single scrap of evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Out Of The Grave : New Forensic Techniques used to Solve Old Cases: Advancement in science and technology are encouraging people to revisit the past in hopes of answering questions that have remained unanswered, and solving crimes that seemed unsolvable.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Natural Witness : The Great Outdoors may offer great clues to solving brutal murders. But it takes the keen eye of the forensic entomologist and botanist to decipher the clues nature provides.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Stolen Identity : When a theft is committed, something valuable is stolen. But when a criminal needs a new identity, theft becomes a matter of life and death.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: A Taste of Poison : Poisoners are the most devious of killers, relying on stealth or their victim's trust in order to steal their lives. They're the most dangerous creatures in the world: smart assassins. And they usually don't stop at one kill.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Betrayed : Sometimes when a death seems to be accidental or the result of a tragic accident, it is up to forensic scientists to reveal the deception lying just below the surface.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Trial Of The Century : Forensics in the O.J. Simpson Murder Trial: Millions watched on television as the jury rendered their verdict. Orenthal James Simpson was found not guilty of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Lethal Dosage : Toxicology: While drugs can cure disease and ease pain, they can also be agents of murder. Toxicologists can examine blood and tissue to uncover cases where death is not as natural as it may seemfrom slow arsenic poisoning to quick cocaine overdoses.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Shreds of Evidence : Hairs and Fibers: The tiniest filament can become a mark of distinction in the most singular and intimate of ways. Investigators have come to rely on forensic evidence as fine as a carpet fiber or as innocent as an eyelash to crack difficult cases.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Invisible Death : Poison is an almost invisible form of death, and toxicologists must look for hidden clues in blood and tissue to bring these murders to light.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Murder By Numbers : For serial killers, once is never enough. For investigators, the challenge is steep when the killers murder by numbers.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Lethal Obsessions : Some people will let nothing stand between them and their goals. In their tortured minds, raw desire replaces all reason, and homicide becomes a convenient means to an end.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Scent Of The Kill : A dog can be a dead man's best friend. Dogs have been trained to sniff out corpses, drugs, explosives, and missing persons. They're often the first to find the essential clue that sets an investigation in motion.

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine
programme.desc: The Dragon Rider : Shimmer, Shine and Leah explore the Dragon Forest and meet Farnaz, a Dragon Rider who teaches them to ride dragons! But when Zeta takes a flock of dragons, including Farnaz's, the girls and Farnaz must work together to stop her before it's too late.

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine
programme.desc: Boom Zahra-Bake!/Rocket's Big Bark : When the girls bake a cake with bouncing flour, it bounces off and they must catch it in time for Roya's Feather Day party! A potion spill turns Rocket's barks magical. But when the magic gets out of control, the kids must find a way to stop it.

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine
programme.desc: Zeta Sleeps Over/Genie Babies : A stinky bug infestation in Zeta's secret lair forces her to spend the night at Shimmer and Shine's Palace. Zeta and Nazboo have to take care of Shimmer, Shine, and Leah when a potion mishap turns them into little babies.

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine
programme.desc: Nazboo Come Home/Surfing the Skies : Nazboo goes off to help a genie with his deliveries, but Zeta worries she's lost him and enlists the girls' help to find him. When the girls learn to cloud surf, Shine gets overexcited and tries to ride the biggest wave at Cloud Beach.

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine
programme.desc: Journey to Zahramay Oceanea : Shimmer, Shine and Leah go to a new place called Zahramay Oceanea to help train a young genie-in-training named Arabella. But when Zeta shows up and tries to take over Oceanea, it's up to the girls and their new friend to stop her.

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine
programme.desc: The Sea Enchantress/The Dance of the Jellyfish : Zeta goes toe-to-toe with a powerful Sea Enchantress named Uzma. When Arabella flubs a wish grant, the girls must quickly fix her mistake or else the Dance of the Jellyfish will be ruined.

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine
programme.desc: Found You Day/Nazboo Loses A Tooth : Zeta's upset when Nazboo abandons her on their special day, unaware that it's because he's planning a surprise party for her! When Nazboo loses one of his baby teeth, Zeta schemes to get a powerful present out of it from the Tooth Flitter.

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine
programme.desc: Zeashell Surprise/The Zahramay Zuffer-Puff : The girls help the Zeashell Genie make surprisefilled zeashells, but sneaky Uzma swaps the surprises inside with her own. The girls run into trouble when Zeta enlists a cute magic-sucking fish to suck up their wish magic.

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine
programme.desc: Zadazzler Dizzaster/Hotdog Havoc : Zeta wreaks havoc when she enchants her sister's new zadazzling wand in an attempt to take over Zahramay Falls. When Zac opens a hotdog stand in Zahramay Falls, Zeta tries using the hotdogs to make her most powerful potion yet.

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine
programme.desc: Ladybugs On the Loose/Zeta the Powerless : When the magical ladybugs escape from Samira's palace, the girls must get them back before Zeta cause trouble with them. When Zeta loses faith in her sorcery abilities, Shimmer, Shine and Leah help her search for something else she'd be good at.

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine
programme.desc: Zeacorn Cove/Lights of Oceanea : When Uzma takes the magic jewel that powers Zeacorn Cove, the girls and their new Zeacorns friends set out to retrieve it. The girls and Arabella discover new magic in a secret cave, but trouble arises when Zeta takes the magic for herself.

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine
programme.desc: Zahra-Zkunked/The Sorcerenie : When Zeta and Nazboo get zkunked by a smelly Zahramay zkunk, Shimmer, Shine and Leah try to help them get un-stinky. Zeta teams up with Shimmer, Shine, Leah and Princess Samira to stop Uzma from taking all the magic from Zahramay Falls.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: Princess Nella's Orc-hestra/The Blaine Game : A wild orc disrupts Nella's concert. Blaine thinks he can do everything better than Nella and sets out to prove it by finding the famous Pink Polka Dotted Dragon Egg.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: Sir Clod/Up All Knight : When Clod loses his invitation to a fabulous breakfast buffet, he leads his friends on a knightly quest to find it. A bright phoenix keeps the whole kingdom awake at night.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: Knighty Knight Dragons/Inside and Seek : When sleepy dragons move into Castlehaven because of a scary monster in their cave, Nella goes in search of it. A wild minotaur causes chaos when she wants to play hide-and-seek inside the castle.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: The Dragon Bully/Royaliscious Plumberry : A dragon bully causes problems in the kingdom. Troublesome creatures overrun the mall when a new ice cream flavor is launched.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: New Kid in the Kingdom/Big Birthday Surprise : A new girl moves to the kingdom – with a big secret to hide. Nella tracks down Garrett's childhood dragon friend for a birthday surprise.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: The Flutter Blunder/A Striking Surprise : When Nella's messenger falcon Flutter mishears her dictating the invitations to Clod's Birthday Party, she delivers some very confusing messages to her guests. Chaos ensues on the day of the Castlehaven bowling tournament!

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: The Sparkle Fest Showdown/The Sparkle Splash Friends Day : Going up against Clod for the Sparkle Fest Championship brings out Trinket's competitive side. Nella has organized a day at the Sparkle Splash Playspace for her friends, but then a mysterious pink mist invades the kingdom.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: That's What Best Friends Are For/In Hot Watermelon : It's the day of a big parade, and Trinket refuses to admit that she is ill. Willow is convinced to enter a gardening contest - and accidentally creates an enormous runaway watermelon.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: Sir Coach's Knightly Trading Card/A Knight's Tale : When Nella and Garrett accidentally ruin Sir Coach's favorite trading card, they go on a quest to make him a new one. A celebrity knight visits Castlehaven – and so does the fearsome dragon he supposedly defeated.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: No Gown, No Crown, No Party/Clod Monet : Olivia convinces Minatori that she must kiss a frog to attend a fancy tea party. Clod lovingly paints pictures of Trinket for the Castlehaven Art Faire - but she doesn't like them!

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: The Share Faire/Hooves Got Talent? : Blaine becomes jealous of Nella at their school's craft fair. After entering a talent show, Clod is embarrassed to discover that he doesn't have the same talent as all the other horses.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: Three's a Crowd/More Than Meets the Eye : Trinket gets jealous when Nella spends time with Minatori at the mall. Nella and Trinket are performing ballet when a near-sighted cyclops crashes their recital.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: Royally Awesome Beach Day/Stop Dragon Me Around : Sea Dragons threaten to spoil Castlehaven's Beach Day. During a scavenger hunt, Smelgly is paired with Olivia, who takes advantage of their new friendship.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: Of Critters and Dragons/Carriages, Carts and Giantmobiles : Nella brings some wild critters to school for show-and-tell, but things soon get out of control. Two rock giant brothers have a disagreement, leaving Nella's family carriage stranded on top of their bridge.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: Sir Coach's Quest/The Dragon Knight : When Sir Coach embarks on a dangerous quest, Nella tags along and realizes she still has a lot to learn. Nella helps Smelgly the dragon fulfill her dream of joining the Knight Brigade.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: Princess Nella's Perfect Family Picture/Giant Trouble : Trinket is desperate to keep things perfect for Royal Family Picture Day. Nella and Norma's 'Best Sisters' playdate is interrupted by two arguing rock giant brothers.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: Dueling Sleepovers/The Great Doodle Star : Nella and Trinket accidently agree to attend both Garrett and Minatori's sleepovers on the same night. Garrett and Blaine disobey the rules and sneak out at night to see a fantastical star.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: The Fanciest of Them All/Practice Makes Progress : Blaine's fancy cousin Olivia visits and questions Nella's ability to be both a princess and a knight. When Nella loses a knightly contest, she's determined to improve by practicing.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: The Knight Before Christmas : It's Christmas Eve in Castlehaven and Santa visits the kingdom. When snow dragons steal his bag of presents, It's up to Nella and her friends to track down the creatures and return the list time for Santa to make his deliveries.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: Let It Snow/Go Dragondaisies! Go! : Nella searches for a magical crystal to make it snow for their annual "Snow Festival." Nella and her friends must play as a team to win the Castlehaven gobletball tournament.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: The Halloween Hippogriff/King Gork the First : Blaine sets out to give everyone a fright at Nella's big Halloween party. Gork has a little too much fun when he's declared King for the Day.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Professeur Chaos : Butters est exclu du groupe des gamins. Excedé, il s'invente un alter-égo maléfique, le Professeur Chaos. Pendant ce temps, Stan, Cartman et Kyle mettent en place une sélection pour trouver un remplaçant à Kenny.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les cathos, c'est chaud : Le père Maxi propose aux enfants de partir pour une croisière en compagnie de prêtres et d'évêques venus de tous les pays. Mais Randy raconte qu'il a entendu aux informations que les prêtres faisaient subir des mauvais traitements aux enfants.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Bérets Gratos : Les gamins en ont marre que les scénaristes retouchent leurs films avec des images de synthèse ou en éditant les images ou les mots choquants.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le camp de la mort de tolérance : Les parents veulent sauver leurs enfants de la spirale de l'intolérance. En même temps Mr Garrison en fait peut-être trop. Et une pauvre gerbille vit un road movie passionnant dans les entrailles de Mr Esclave.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le Plus Gros Connard de l'Univers : Chef et Mme Cartman décident de purger Eric de l'âme de Kenny. Pendant ce temps Stan tente de prouver que John Edward est un imposteur. Les voies de la solution s'avèreront d'ordre stellaire.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Mon Futur Moi et Moi : Un homme se présentant comme le Stan Marsh du futur arrive à South Park. Le Stan du passé est littéralement effaré de voir qu'il tombera dans une telle déchéance.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La Chute du traîneau rouge : Cartman est très tendu. Il a commis trop de mauvaises actions pour espérer avoir des cadeaux à ce Noël. Il tente alors de se racheter en convaincant le Père Noël d'apporter Noël en Irak.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: I'm a Little Bit Country : La sonde anale de Cartman est réactivée. Les garçons se retrouvent dans l'espace et ils ont une mission très, très importante: Sauver la terre!

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les gangs de Denver : Timmy aide Jimmy à former un club composé d'autres enfants handicapés de naissance. Ils sont heureux de découvrir qu'un groupe de ce genre existe déjà.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Papier toilette : Cartman veut faire une crasse à son prof, qui vient de le punir. Pour se venger, il demande aux garçons de se joindre à lui pour remplir la maison du prof de papier toilette.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Gros Cul et Tête de Nœud : Kyle vient de réaliser un brillant exposé sur la culture hispano-américaine. C'est désormais au tour de Cartman de se lancer dans un discours sur les artistes hispano-américains.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les petits policiers : Les enfants décident de jouer les détectives privés. Leur première affaire consiste à retrouver une tarte à la cerise.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La Cupidité de L'Homme Rouge : Monsieur Broslofsky perd tout son argent dans un casino indien. Les indiens rachètent South Park pour construire une autoroute géante.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: est Gay! : La nouvelle folie 'métrosexuelle' (un show télévisé) envahit la ville de South Park.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Rock chrétien : Suite à un pari avec Kyle, Cartman décide de monter un groupe de rock chrétien avec Token et Butters, dans le but d'obtenir un disque de platine.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Rencontre du troisième âge : À South Park, comme dans tout le pays, les vieux au volant sont considérés comme un fléau. Une loi est votée pour leur confisquer leur permis de conduire. Mais le troisième âge contre-attaque.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Casa Bonita : La mère de Kyle doit emmener ce dernier et ses amis à Casa Bonita, une version mexicaine de Disneyland au Colorado. Au lieu d'inviter Cartman, Kyle lui préfère Butters.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Tout sur les Mormons : Un enfant mormon arrive dans la classe des garçons. Stan est supposé lui casser la figure, mais son père et lui sont soudain fascinés par la religion des nouveaux venus, et leur extrême gentillesse. Stan ne tardera pas à revenir sur son avis.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stop clopes : Les garçons sont surpris en train de fumer après avoir vu un spectacle ringard contre la cigarette. Rob Reiner, militant extrémiste anti-tabac, décide de piéger les fabricants de cigarettes avec l'aide des garçons.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Raisins : Stan déprime quand Wendy le plaque. Ses amis l'emmènent alors au 'Raisins', réputé pour ses hôtesses de bar sexy. Butters tombe amoureux de l'une d'entre elles, et Stan décide de devenir gothique.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Noël au Canada : Les parents biologiques d'Ike reviennent le chercher chez les parents de Kyle.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les armes, c'est rigolo : Grâce à un stratagème surfait, les garçons obtiennent des armes ninja. Alors qu'ils jouent, ils blessent leur camarade Butters. Pris dans un dilemme draconien, les garçons décident de le déguiser en chien pour l'emmener chez le véterinaire.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Génial-O : Cartman s'habille comme un robot, s'auto-proclame 'Génial-O' et déménage chez Butters pour découvrir tous ses secrets et les utiliser contre lui.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les stéroïdes ça déchire : Jimmy s'entraîne pour un événement sportif imminent et est déterminé à gagner à n'importe quel prix. Cartman décide qu'il peut facilement remporter la première place contre Jimmy.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La passion du juif : Cartman a vu le film « La Passion du Christ ». Depuis, il est fan de Mel Gibson et de son film. Il veut alors monter un fan-club très spécial.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les Gluants : Des humains de l'an 4035 débarquent à South Park à travers un portail temporel et recherchent du travail.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les Jefferson : Une nouvelle famille arrive à South Park : les Jefferson. Monsieur Jefferson accueille les enfants de South Park chez lui pour les faire jouer dans son parc personnel.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Poire à lavement et sandwich au caca : La SPA manifeste contre l'utilisation d'une vache comme mascotte de l'école élémentaire de South Park. Les écoliers sont obligés d'en choisir une autre.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le Supermarché des Ténèbres : La rue principale de South Park se transforme en ville fantôme quand un supermarché géant Wall Mart attire les citadins jusqu'à son tout nouveau magasin aux affaires incroyables.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Maternelle : Cela fait cinq ans que Trent Boyett est en prison. Celui-ci y est incarcéré, à la place des garçons, pour avoir brûlé leur professeur de maternelle. Quand il sort de prison, les enfants paniquent alors à l'idée de sa vengeance.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Course à l'audience : Les garçons de South Park produisent leur propre journal d'informations du matin sur la station de télévision de l'école, et sont immédiatement entraînés dans une intense course à l'audience.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kit vidéo pour stupide pute trop gâtée : Paris Hilton ouvre une boutique en ville, dans laquelle toutes les petites filles pourront acheter de quoi se transformer en parfaite peste. Son chien s'étant suicidé, Paris veut acheter Butters pour le remplacer.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le don incroyable de Cartman : Après avoir reçu une sévère blessure à la tête, Cartman se voit doté de dons de voyance.

programme.title: Arthur

programme.title: Arthur

programme.title: Arthur

programme.title: Arthur

programme.desc: The Odd Squad/For Emergencies Only : The Odd Squad/For Emergencies Only: Timmy wishes he had a talking car. Cosmo and Wanda are so busy with Poof they’re neglecting Timmy.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Cheese and Crockers/Land Before Timmy : Cheese and Crockers/Land Before Timmy: Timmy wishes up a machine that allows him to merge with other items to become half-Timmy/half-whatever. Timmy’s tired of technology taking over and ruining his life so he wishes for a simpler world.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Merry Wishmas! : Merry Wishmas!: When Timmy doesn’t get what he wants for Christmas he simply wishes for it. But his friends can’t do the same, so Timmy wishes every kid could get a magical coupon that would allow them to wish for the one thing they didn't get.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: 9 Lives/Dread 'n' Breakfast : 9 Lives/Dread 'n' Breakfast: When Catman tells Timmy that he’s used up 8 of his 9 cat lives saving Dimmsdale from crime, Timmy helps Catman find a "safer" job where he can still help people. Mom turns the house into a bed and breakfast!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Birthday Bashed/Momnipresent : Birthday bashed/Momnipresent: Timmy is excited for his birthday until he realizes that one year older means one year closer to losing his fairies. He spends the entire day trying to thwart all party plans, leading his Mom and Dad to think he's gone crazy!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Wishology: The Big Beginning Pt1 : Timmy goes on an adventure to search for his fairies and a magical wand that will defeat the Darkness.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Wishology: The Big Beginning Pt2 : Timmy goes on an adventure to search for his fairies and a magical wand that will defeat the Darkness.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Wishology: The Exciting Middle Part (Part 1) : Timmy learns he merely slowed down The Darkness and now he must seek a second wand to defeat this evil force. Timmy is forced to make amends with his enemies in order to fight for mankind.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Wishology: The Final Ending (Part 1) : Confident and secure, Timmy feels great having won the battle against The Darkness. His world is quickly turned upside down as he learns that he didn’t win, but is now living inside The Darkness!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Anti-Poof : Anti-Poof: For every fairy, there’s an anti-fairy – thus anti-Poof is born – FOOP! It’s up to Poof to stop this anti-fairy from destroying Fairy World and his loved ones.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Add-A-Dad/Squirrely Puffs : Add-A-Dad/Squirrely Puffs: Dad is too busy to spend quality time with Timmy, so he wishes up "a-lot-a-dads" to hang out with. It's a race between the Squirrely Scouts and the Cream Puffs to the top of Mount Doom!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Mice-Capades/Formula For Disaster : Mice-Capades/Formula For Disaster: Poof has been watching too much of a classic, yet violent "cat & mouse" cartoon. He innocently turns Timmy and Vicky into "Cheesy and Sleazy" and all mayhem breaks loose.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Bad Heir Day/Freaks and Greeks : Bad Heir Day/Freaks and Greeks: Crocker wants an heir to his supposed "fortune and fame." Poof coincidentally ends up in his care and Crocker is set for life.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Fly Boy/Temporary Fairy : Fly Boy/Temporary Fairy: Everybody in Dimmsdale is watching the latest horror film, "Fly Boy." But Timmy isn't allowed to, so when he wishes to become a "fly on the wall".

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Crocker Shocker/Super Zero : Crocker Shocker/Super Zero: Crocker is hypnotized into no longer believing in fairies and becomes normal again. Unfortunately, Fairy World can no longer feed off his spastic energy, and all their magic shuts down.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Dadbracadbra/Timmy Turnip : Dadbracadbra/Timmy Turnip: With a little help from Timmy, Dad’s magic tricks really work. Convinced that Timmy’s dad is a fairy, Crocker is out to prove it and uncover his secret on national television.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: One Man Banned/Frenemy Mine : One Man Banned/Frenemy Mine: After Timmy’s rejected from the school band, he wishes everyone would love his music./Timmy saves Vicky from a horrible accident and suddenly she is stricken by his generosity.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Chicken Poofs/Stupid Cupid : Chicken Poofs/Stupid Cupid: Poof gets the "Chicken Poofs" and turns everyone into actual chickens! Timmy steals Cupid's arrows in an attempt to make Trixie fall in love with him and go to the school "Romance Dance."

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Double Oh Schnozmo/Planet Poof : Double Oh Schnozmo/Planet Poof: Cosmo’s brother, the top secret spy, pays a visit. But when Schnozmo’s revealed to be nothing but a con man, Wanda demands that Schnozmo participate in a real spy adventure in order to spare Cosmo’s feelings.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: The Boss of Me/He Poofs, He Scores! : It's "Bring Your Kid to Work Day," and Dad takes Timmy to his office. When Timmy accidentally eats Poof (who is hiding as a marshmallow in Timmy's cereal) Timmy becomes magically talented at soccer.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Play Date...of Doom/Teacher's Pet : Play Date... of Doom/Teacher's Pet: Foop is back! He’s escaped from prison and convinced Cosmo and Wanda he’s ready for a playdate with Poof. But he’s really there to try and destroy his arch enemy again, and it’s up to Timmy and Poof to thwart his plan.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Manic Mom-Day/Crocker of Gold : When Timmy gripes that being Mom is easier than being a kid, Wanda takes the bait and switches their brains. Now Mom is Timmy, and Timmy is Mom!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Poltergeeks/Beach Blanket Bozo : When Mom and Dad mistake Cosmo for a ghost and restart their failed ghost-hunting business, Timmy wishes that the fairies would pretend to haunt Dimmsdale.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Old Man and the C-/Balance of Flour : After failing miserably on a game show for 6th graders, Dad admits he dropped out of school in the 5th grade. The next thing Timmy knows, Dad’s in his class!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Food Fight/Please Don't Feed the Turners : Food Fight/Please Don't Feed the Turners: Tired of Mom’s terrible dinners, Timmy wishes Mom were the best chef in the world.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Take and Fake/Cosmo Rules : Timmy borrows Mark Chang’s Fake-i-fier in order to attend Trixie’s costume party. Unfortunately, he knows nothing about Yugopotamian technology and soon the device is causing Timmy to turn into all sorts of crazy creatures.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Lights Out/Dad Overboard : An exhausted Timmy makes a wish for complete darkness so he can get some sleep. But he doesn’t count on Cosmo and Wanda turning into Scary Fairies in the dark.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Farm Pit/Crock Talk : Dad decides to convert the Turner home into a farm. Unfortunately, it takes Cosmo and Wanda’s magic to give Dad a green thumb, and when they’re swept away by a tornado, it’s up to Timmy to save the farm...and his fairies!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Operation Dinkleberg/Spellementary School : Dad changes Timmy’s room into a surveillance center to prove that his kindly neighbor, Dinkleberg, is truly evil. Being the best neighbor ever, Dinkleberg pretends to be evil just to make Dad feel better.

programme.desc: Love Triangle : Poof and Foop compete to win the affections of Goldie Goldenglow, a magical new girl at Spellementary School (who’s shaped like a triangle) while participating in the Spellementary School play, "Mr. Cookie’s Happy Day."

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys
programme.desc: The Fire-Ing Squad! : An unexpected Pokémon firefighting competition reunites our heroes with some old friends, the Squirtle Squad! But they are in desperate need of some leadership, so Ash and Squirtle rejoin the ranks.

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys
programme.desc: Hot Matches : When Ash hears of a virtually unbeatable Trainer nearby, he's itching to take on the challenge. But both Brock’s Vulpix and Ash’s Cyndaquil take a beating from her Skarmory, even with their type advantage! How can Ash defeat it?

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys
programme.desc: Love, Totodile Style : Ash’s Totodile develops a crush on a passing Azumarill, the star performer of a Pokémon circus. When Team Rocket arrives to steal the show, Azumarill’s heart isn't the only thing Totodile has to win!

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys
programme.desc: The Psychic Sidekicks : After seeing a sign in the forest warning them about mischievous Ghost-type Pokémon, our heroes reach a town whose residents use Psychic types to repel them. But soon some spooky news arrives: a giant Gengar is on the loose!

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys
programme.desc: The Fortune Hunters : A sudden craze in Pokémon fortune-telling turns out to be a plot to steal Pokémon from local Trainers. But Jessie, James and Meowth aren't behind it this time! Who are these con artists?

programme.title: Pokemon: Johto League Champions
programme.desc: A Goldenrod Opportunity : Arriving in Goldenrod City, Ash is ready for his next Gym battle, but the Gym appears to be closed. Their plans delayed, our heroes decide to explore the vibrant city.

programme.title: Pokemon: Johto League Champions
programme.desc: A Dairy Tale Ending : After losing to Whitney at the Goldenrod Gym, Ash is thinking of a rematch with her powerful Miltank. When Whitney suggests a trip to a Miltank dairy, it’s just the chance he's is looking for!

programme.title: Pokemon: Johto League Champions
programme.desc: Air Time : With his new Gym badge in hand, Ash is asked to appear on a local radio station. But while he's acting out a radio drama with some 'professional actors,' the scripted danger becomes all too lifelike!

programme.title: Pokemon: Johto League Champions
programme.desc: The Bug Stops Here : A Bug Pokémon Catching Contest turns into a hive of activity when Ash goes up against his rival Casey—and it isn’t long before the Team Rocket villains swarm the scene, intent on catching a few things for themselves…

programme.title: Pokemon: Johto League Champions
programme.desc: Type Casting! : On the way to Ecruteak City, our heroes are trapped on the wrong side of a river. To get across, they first have to find a Sudowoodo...which, even for an expert, is no easy feat!

programme.title: Pokemon: Johto League Champions
programme.desc: Fossil Fools : When an ex-student of Professor Oak’s discovers some restored Omanyte and Omastar in the wild, our heroes are called into action to save these prehistoric Pokémon from harsh times with Team Rocket!

programme.title: Pokemon: Johto League Champions
programme.desc: Carrying On : The Pidgey Express courier service is in need of our heroes' helping hands, especially when Team Rocket wants to have the delivery Pidgey signed, sealed, and delivered to the Boss!

programme.title: Pokemon: Johto League Champions
programme.desc: Hassle In The Castle : Caught in a sudden downpour, our heroes find a castle clinic that uses Pokémon healers to help patients. But when Brock and the doctor end up trapped in the castle's labyrinth, a helping hand is needed to get them out!

programme.title: Pokemon: Johto League Champions

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Salvador, Brazil : Tony heads back to his much-beloved Salvador, Brazil. The ever-present street festivals and the famous Carnival parade begin with sitting down with a local artist in the streets of the historic Pelo.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Massachusetts : This unique episode looks closely at the “other” Massachusetts far away from the blue blood getaways of Nantucket or the urban sprawl of Boston that most people know so little about.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Congo : Bourdain looks at the Congo as one of the more industrialized powers in Africa now largely crumbled to nothingness and chaos with Tim Butcher author of Blood River.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Las Vegas : Tony travels to Las Vegas Nevada with his food author friend Michael Ruhlman. Whatever your need, whatever bad behaviour you’d like to display Las Vegas is the place that will allow it... for a price.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Mexico City : Tony travels to Mexico City and Oaxaca to meet who fight for the food, the art, and the lives they believe in. In the Santa Anita neighbourhood of Mexico City, Tony meets boxer Jorge Lacierva.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: New Jersey : In this episode of Parts Unknown Tony travels back to his homeland, his roots, his favorite state in the union: New Jersey. Part nostalgia, part cautionary tale. Tony makes sure to hit up some NJ classics.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Shanghai : Anthony Bourdain explores the vibrant, dynamic city of Shanghai.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Colombia : Tony will explore several regions of Colombia from the mountains down to the Caribbean coast to the coca leaf growing inlands formerly controlled by drug cartels.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tokyo : Tony travels to Tokyo in search of the city's dark, extreme underside.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Madagascar : In this episode of Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown, Tony travels to Madagascar, a place that outsiders understand surprisingly little about.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey
